Highlight Clip: Tom Lee: We've Been Advocating a 2% Crypto Position Tom Lee: We've Been Advocating a 2% Crypto Position Description: On September 11, 2026, BitMine Chairman Tom Lee said in an interview with Wealthion that he has long advocated a 2% crypto position for investors with no crypto exposure. He noted that for some Fundstrat clients who followed the recommendation, the original 2% allocation has grown to more than 85% of their portfolios due to Bitcoin’s substantial price appreciation, rather than additional purchases. Lee believes that over the next decade, crypto could provide exposure with relatively low correlation to other assets, benefit from the growth of AI, and become an important part of how the financial services industry reinvents itself. WuBlockchain notes that Tom Lee's market forecasts tend to be optimistic. His bullish targets may not materialize, and actual market performance may differ significantly from his predictions. Readers are encouraged to focus on his analytical reasoning rather than use specific price targets or timelines as a basis for investment decisions. — link

SlowMist: Hackers Implement Full-Chain iOS Exploit to Steal Private Keys and Mnemonic Phrases Across Versions 13 to 26.5 SlowMist Chief Information Security Officer 23pds has issued an urgent security warning advising all iOS users to update their devices immediately. He disclosed that cybercriminals have actively operationalized a full-chain exploit framework capable of silently exfiltrating private keys and mnemonic seed phrases directly from iOS devices. The attack execution pathway involves: luring targets to a malicious webpage via Safari through social engineering or watering-hole tactics, triggering memory corruption in WebKit/JavaScriptCore (JSC) to secure arbitrary read/write access at the JavaScript layer, subsequently bypassing Pointer Authentication Codes (PAC) to achieve native code execution, escaping the WebContent sandbox, and completing kernel privilege escalation to root to drain device Keychains and local crypto wallet application data. The potentially affected versions are reported to span iOS 13 through iOS 26.5 (pending final confirmation). — link

Interpol Expands Silver Notice System, Identifies at Least €36M in Criminal Assets According to AP, Interpol is expanding its Silver Notice system, which allows its 196 member countries to share information and assist in tracing and seizing cross-border criminal assets, including cash, cryptocurrency, vehicles and real estate. Trialed since January 2025, the system has involved 82 countries and identified at least €36 million in criminal assets. Interpol says criminals generally retain around 99% of their illicit proceeds. The first Silver Notice was requested by Italy for a senior mafia member, after which Brazil identified multiple properties and other assets linked to the suspect and his associates. Interpol members are expected to vote on the system’s full adoption at the General Assembly in Hong Kong in November 2026. — link

Highlight Clip: Tom Lee: Every Crypto Winter Has Had "Rage Quitting" Tom Lee: Every Crypto Winter Has Had "Rage Quitting" On September 11, 2026, BitMine Chairman Tom Lee said in an interview with Wealthion that every crypto winter tends to share three characteristics: sharp price declines, leverage being wiped out, and some investors "rage quitting" after suffering heavy losses. In his view, recent public declarations by prominent figures that they have lost faith in Bitcoin are typical of what happens near the bottom of each cycle. Although many dismissed the rally over the past six weeks as a head fake, Lee said the market now appears to have technically bottomed.
